meta.name: support-operations
meta.description: Designs and runs the support function — channels, queues, routing, staffing, service levels, quality, and the metrics that show whether it is working. Use this to set up or fix support operations, choose channels, size a team, set or renegotiate service levels, reduce cost per contact, diagnose long queues or poor quality, or decide what to automate.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并优化客服运营体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责客服支持,需要设计流程、调配人力或优化成本。
copy.tagline_en: Design and optimize your customer support operations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a support team and need to fix queues, staffing, or service levels.

howto.what: Claude 会先抽样分析你的客服记录,找出造成大部分来量的根因,再按成本从低到高设计处理方式:先消除或引导自助,再考虑自动化,最后才派人工;并据此规划渠道、服务水平、人员编制和质检指标。
howto.when: 当你提出搭建/优化客服运营、设定服务水平、诊断排队或质量等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析最近的客服工单,找出来量最多的原因。
say.note: Claude 会抽样分类并建议优先解决的点。

say.text: 我们客服队列积压严重,帮我诊断怎么处理。
say.note: 按处理层级给出从源头消除到人工协助的方案。

say.text: 帮我制定服务水平目标,并评估团队能否达到。
say.note: 先看产能再定承诺,避免做不到的 SLA。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes support samples to find top volume causes, then designs handling by cost hierarchy (eliminate, deflect, self-serve, automate, assist) and plans channels, SLAs, staffing, quality metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design or improve support, set service levels, or diagnose queues/quality.

say_en.text: Analyze our recent support tickets and find the top causes of volume.
say_en.note: Lists root causes and suggests priorities.

say_en.text: Our queue is backing up; diagnose how to fix it.
say_en.note: Proposes actions from eliminating causes to adding human help.

say_en.text: Help set service-level targets and check if the team can meet them.
